description: The chart titled “QA-1” presents a horizontal stacked bar comparison of three models’ outcome proportions across response-quality categories. The category axis is the vertical (y) axis, listing (top to bottom) “Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B,” “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” and “RedWhale (our),” with no explicit sorting indicator beyond this displayed order. The value axis is horizontal and represents proportions on a linear scale from 0 to 1 (not explicitly labeled with units), with each bar spanning the full width to a total of 1.0 via stacked segments. Each model’s bar is divided into three colored segments corresponding to the legend: a dark purple segment labeled “Correct,” a medium blue segment labeled “Partially Correct,” and a light blue segment (legend text not visible) representing the remaining category; segment values are printed inside the bars. For “Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B,” the stacked segments are approximately 0.88 (Correct, dark purple), 0.08 (Partially Correct, medium blue), and 0.04 (light blue). For “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” the segments are approximately 0.96 (Correct), 0.00 (Partially Correct, shown as “0”), and 0.04 (light blue). For “RedWhale (our),” the segments are approximately 0.96 (Correct), 0.00 (Partially Correct), and 0.04 (light blue). No bars appear specially emphasized with outlines or annotations beyond the in-segment numeric labels.
